name: Hungary
spiritual_teacher: Christian monasteries (Pannonhalma Archabbey, Benedictine & Franciscan traditions) and Budapest philosophical circles
work_strategy: Remote via Temporary Protection (menedékes) or local egyéni vállalkozó (KATA is B2C-only; B2B uses átalányadózás / standard EV). White Card nomad visa requires 3,000 €/mo.
it_market: Strong (Budapest is a major Central European tech & R&D hub: Bosch, Ericsson, GoTo, banks; English working language in IT)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; after 183 days worldwide income taxed: 15% flat PIT (SZJA) + 18.5% TB + 13% SZOCHO (31.5% social on min base ≥322,800 HUF/mo ≈ 281 €/mo fixed floor; KATA is B2C-only).
climate: Continental (warm summers, cold winters with ~7 heating months below 15°C).
nature: Danube River, Lake Balaton, Bükk & Mátra hills, thermal springs
english_level: Moderate (High in Budapest IT/corporate bubble; strictly Hungarian in government offices, healthcare, and small towns)
housing_rent: Moderate / High (Country avg 1-bed outside centre ~390–410 €, Budapest ~550–580 €)

price_sources.summary: [Numbeo Hungary](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/country_result.jsp?country=Hungary) (1-bedroom outside centre ~150,909 HUF / ~400 € country avg, ~211,842 HUF / ~565 € Budapest; single person living without rent ~695 €).
numbeo_mandatory_fields: Estimated monthly costs for a single person without rent (food, transport, basic household)
Basic utilities (Electricity, Heating, Cooling, Water, Garbage) + Internet (Broadband)

citizenship: 8 years standard naturalization (Hungarian language & constitutional exam required); 3 years if married to HU citizen or parent of HU minor
mortgage_expats: Possible with permanent residence permit + lakcímkártya (address card) + 30–45 day property purchase permit for non-EU nationals
rent_to_buy: Rare (Mainly standard market rentals or developer installments)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Ukrainian passport or ID. Under EU Temporary Protection Directive Article 7, Hungary grants menedékes status to military-age Ukrainian men without requiring military deregistration.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary protection (menedékes státusz) — extended under EU framework through March 4, 2028; older physical cards remain valid by decree.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **EU country WITH Article 7 exception: Hungary formally notified the European Commission that it will NOT deny temporary protection to military-age Ukrainian men under EU Decision 2026/1912.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: Monthly state financial living allowance for registered menedékes beneficiaries; family & municipal support.
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: State-funded accommodation channeled mainly via contracted charities (e.g., Maltese Charity Service) and municipalities rather than open private landlord subsidies.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Access to state emergency and basic public healthcare upon submitting the menedékes application and receiving local ID numbers.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Local/regional public transport discounts or free passes available in several municipalities (e.g., Budapest BKK passes for Ukrainian refugees).
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Simplified employment without a separate work permit under menedékes status.
